text:
maya: Quick design check — uploaded a compact roles matrix mock + invite flow tweaks in Figma: https://figma.com/file/ABC123 (compact view vs expanded)

maya: Main asks — does the compact layout still make role affordances discoverable? Is the SSO toggle label clear for admins? Also spotted potential keyboard focus trap in the invite drawer.

aj: Looks really tight, love the density. Two quick nits: the role pill hover needs a stronger affordance (outline + subtle bg change) and the checkbox for "Make this user an admin" is below the fold on smaller windows.

aj: For SSO label, I prefer "Require SSO for org sign-in" over "Enforce SSO" — slightly more discoverable wording. :thumbsup:

tom: Re: affordance — +1 on the outline. Also suggest an icon (shield) next to SSO toggle, helps visual scan. But be careful with color reliance; use icon + text for accessibility.

tom: Regarding focus trap — when you open invite drawer and hit tab backwards it jumps out of the drawer header, we should ensure focus remains inside and that Esc closes it. I can paste a quick ARIA snippet if helpful.

lina: Here's the ARIA snippet that worked for other drawers:

```
role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="invite-drawer-title"
trapFocus(); // internal helper to pin keyboard focus
```

lina: Also add "aria-describedby" on the SSO toggle explaining what happens to existing sessions when you enable it.

sam: Microcopy suggestion for invite CTA — currently says "Send invite". For multi-role invites maybe make it "Invite and assign roles" (or change copy dynamically when roles selected). Helps set expectation that roles are applied immediately.

sam: One more thing — audit log nav: we should persist the filter state when moving between org settings pages. Right now filters reset which is surprising.

olivia: UX research found admins expect to preview effective permissions before sending invites. Could we show a small inline summary on hover of a role pill like "Can manage models, view billing"? That would reduce clicks.

maya: Good calls. Action items:
- update SSO toggle copy to "Require SSO for org sign-in" and add a short helper text (aria-describedby) explaining session behavior (lina)
- stronger role affordance + shield icon (tom + aj)
- fix focus trap and Esc behavior in invite drawer (lina)
- dynamic invite CTA when roles selected (sam)
- hover permission summary for role pills (olivia)
- persist audit log filters across settings nav (eng ticket)

maya: Quick priority ask: can design deliver a 1-screen variant with the affordance + hover summary by EOD so we can sync with eng for the filter persistence? :eyes:

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-4829: "Invite drawer keyboard trap + SSO helper copy" and assigned to eng-ux.

aj: I'll take PROD-4829 and scope the implementation work with eng tomorrow.

maya: Thanks all — will update the Figma with the copy and the aria note.
